content.text: Netflix has thousands of series, so choosing the next one is hard. These are my top 10 Netflix series of all time: shows that topped the Netflix Top 10 around the world and are still worth watching from the first episode.
1. Stranger Things
Friends in a small American town fight monsters from the Upside Down. Five seasons of adventure, horror and friendship, and the series that made Netflix famous for originals.
2. Squid Game
A deadly game show for people in debt, from South Korea. The most watched Netflix series ever, with a complete story in three seasons.
3. Money Heist
The Professor and his crew pull off the biggest robberies in Spain. Fast, emotional and full of twists.
4. Wednesday
Wednesday Addams solves a murder mystery at Nevermore Academy. Dark comedy, mystery and one of the most famous dance scenes on the internet.
5. Bridgerton
Romance and scandal in Regency-era London, following the eight Bridgerton siblings as they look for love. Each season focuses on a different member of the family.
6. The Last Kingdom
Uhtred, a Saxon raised by Danes, fights for the birth of England. Five seasons of battles and politics, plus the film Seven Kings Must Die. If you like it, watch Vikings: Valhalla next.
7. Cobra Kai
Thirty years after The Karate Kid, Johnny Lawrence and Daniel LaRusso meet again. Funny, nostalgic and full of karate fights, across six seasons.
8. The Umbrella Academy
Adopted siblings with strange powers reunite to stop the end of the world, again and again. Four seasons of superheroes who are a mess.
9. Dark
Time travel, family secrets and one of the smartest stories on television. The best German series on Netflix.
10. Ozark
A family launders money for a cartel in the Missouri Ozarks. Tense from start to finish.
